title: Bahia dashboard detail interactions and service-secret copy cleanup
description: Refine the Bahia dashboard and service detail UX by enlarging the top-bar logo, removing an obsolete nav badge, exposing human-readable dashboard entities with hover and dialog affordances, making recent-activity timestamps timezone-aware, and removing incorrect encrypted-request wording from service-secret unavailability messaging.
in_scope: Pending Approvals nav item badge removal
Environment States name rendering, ID tooltips, and entity detail dialogs
Recent Activity timezone labels, hover details, event detail dialog, and shortened entity names
Service-secret unavailability copy for encrypted Nostr events
out_of_scope: Reworking the broader encrypted controlplane terminology used outside the requested service-secret path
Repairing the legacy service-secrets smoke suite beyond filing a tracked follow-up
preconditions: Dashboard relay-backed read models are available in browser mocks for e2e verification
The service-secret store remains the authority for encrypted-secret availability checks
postconditions: Operators can identify dashboard entities by name without losing access to IDs
Operators can inspect service, environment, and event detail without leaving the dashboard
Service-secret unavailability messaging no longer refers to fictional encrypted request relays
happy_paths: User opens the dashboard and sees named service/environment state entries with tooltip IDs and clickable detail dialogs
User inspects recent activity with local timezone labels, UTC hover detail, and full event detail dialogs
User encountering unavailable encrypted secret management sees copy that points to encrypted Nostr events and Settings
failure_paths: Dashboard activity rows must not manufacture incorrect deployment links from service entity IDs
The broader legacy service-secrets smoke suite currently fails before coverage due to stale assumptions and is tracked separately
edge_cases: Activity rows may have service/environment names in event payloads even when local stores are not yet hydrated
Interactive controls inside tables must remain clickable without forcing the whole row to look clickable
non_functional_requirements: Verification includes targeted unit coverage, browser smoke coverage, and a production build
Dialog behavior remains keyboard accessible via existing modal focus management
dependencies: SvelteKit app shell and modal component
Relay-backed controlplane browser mocks in web/tests/e2e/helpers.js
human_decisions: Environment-state service names open a service dialog; environment names open an environment dialog.
